fieldValues.title: A person working with AI in Semantic records
fieldValues.summary: Someone who relies on the spec, its schemas and its tools agreeing, and on rulings reaching every layer.
goals: Trust that spec, schema and tool say the same thing
Change a record's type without losing its identity
jobs: Keep standards to a size that can be held
Evolve records as the spec evolves
fieldValues.needs: One source of meaning, rulings carried into every layer, and change that keeps identity.
